source_name: ТТК Банка АД Скопје — Извештаи и податоци за Банката
why_relevant: Publishes the standardised supervisory 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' disclosure (the NBRM-mandated Pillar-3-equivalent public disclosure) as a dated PDF, e.g. as at 31.12.2024; this template is common across MK banks and yields comparable capital/risk and operational-risk data. Site also carries card-usage guidance pages.

source_name: Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје — Извештаи и податоци (ccbank.mk)
why_relevant: Bulgarian-CCB-affiliated small bank with a dedicated reports page and published audited financial statements; completes the bank-universe coverage so aggregate card/ATM tallies built from bank disclosures are not systematically short on the tail banks.

source_name: Македонска берза (MSE) — issuer pages and announcement repository
why_relevant: Single highest-leverage pointer for this cell: every listed MK bank has an issuer page (Комерцијална, НЛБ/TNB, УНИ, ТТК, ЦКБ, Шпаркасе/INB, Халк, Силк Роуд) with a chronological announcement feed whose Repository/Announcement166 PDFs are the filed audited statements and annual reports. Also publishes public reprimands ('јавна опомена') naming issuers that missed disclosure deadlines — a free reliability signal per bank.

source_name: SEI-Net (seinet.com.mk) — electronic disclosure system for MSE-listed issuers
why_relevant: The statutory electronic channel through which listed issuers, including all listed MK banks, publish price-sensitive information and periodic reports; documents are served from a FileServer.aspx?file=<id> endpoint, so a numeric-ID crawl plus issuer filter gives a complete machine-collectable filing archive that is often fresher than the banks' own websites.

source_name: Комисија за хартии од вредност — SRIS public reports portal (sris.sec.gov.mk)
why_relevant: The Securities Commission's reporting system hosts issuer filings including bank consolidated financial statements (a Шпаркасе Банка consolidated draft was served directly from it), giving a regulator-side archive that survives bank website redesigns and captures entities that are reporting but not actively traded.

source_name: НБРМ bank-directory pages (nbrm.mk ns-newsarticle-<bank>.nspx)
why_relevant: The central bank maintains one canonical page per licensed bank (official name, licence, ownership, contact, links) — the authoritative actor map for this cell and the way to confirm the exact legal names, spot mergers/renames, and enumerate the full bank universe rather than working from a stale list.

source_name: SeeNews — South-East Europe company news (North Macedonia banking)
why_relevant: English-language regional wire that converts MK bank filings into dated, comparable summaries (e.g. NLB Banka 2024 net profit +2.4% y/y with EUR/USD conversion), giving a fast timeline of when each bank reported and a sanity check on headline figures — useful when the primary PDF is Cyrillic-only and OCR-hostile.

source_name: Bank ATM/branch locator pages as a network-census source (halkbank.mk/atm-mapa, nlb.mk expozituri)
why_relevant: Where banks do not publish ATM counts in prose, their public locator pages are an authoritative live census of the ATM and branch fleet by location — the only route to per-bank ATM geography, and a way to track fleet growth/contraction between annual reports. NLB's 'Експозитури' page is the branch-side equivalent.

source_name: Bank card-product pages (e.g. Комерцијална банка 'Дебитни'/'Кредитни' картички)
why_relevant: Product catalogues per bank reveal the card schemes carried (Visa/Mastercard/domestic), product tiers, contactless/tokenisation support, and fee schedules — the qualitative substrate behind card statistics, and the only public route to per-bank scheme mix. Fee tariff PDFs ('тарифник') on the same sites additionally price ATM withdrawals and POS acceptance.

source_name: Комерцијална банка АД Скопје — Тарифа на надоместоци (платежни услуги во денари и девизи)
why_relevant: Largest MK retail bank (now NLB Komercijalna group context). Dated PDF tariff listing card issuing fees, ATM cash-withdrawal pricing (own/other bank/abroad), account maintenance and payment-traffic fees — direct evidence of cash-vs-card pricing for consumers.

source_name: Комерцијална банка — Општи услови за платежна сметка и платежни услуги (физички лица / нерезиденти)
why_relevant: General terms of business define which fee items exist, value dating, card transaction rules and FX mark-up mechanics — the qualitative layer needed to interpret the numeric tariff.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — Тарифи (физички лица / правни лица) hub
why_relevant: Second systemically important bank and a major acquirer. Landing hub linking current and historical tariff PDFs for retail and corporate, including card and payment-traffic fees; the corporate tariff carries POS/acquiring-related items.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — Општи правила и услови за прифаќање на платежни трансакции засновани на картички (merchant acquiring terms)
why_relevant: Rare public merchant-acquiring contract terms: card acceptance rules, chargeback handling, settlement timing and the basis on which the merchant service charge is levied. Highest-value document type in this cell because acquiring pricing is normally opaque.

source_name: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје — Трошоци, провизии и каматни стапки (тарифа)
why_relevant: NLB is a top-3 issuer/acquirer; page hosts the current tariff decision plus dated excerpts for individuals and legal entities, including card fees and ATM withdrawal pricing.

source_name: Халкбанк АД Скопје — Генерална тарифа / Тарифа (население и правни лица)
source_subtype: bank tariff hub + generalna tarifa PDF
why_relevant: Halkbank is one of five MK e-commerce acquiring banks and an aggressive price competitor (publicised tariff cuts, free cross-bank ATM withdrawals for salary clients) — a leading indicator of cash-withdrawal price competition.

source_name: Шпаркасе Банка Македонија — Надоместоци и тарифи (правни лица) / Тарифник за физички лица
why_relevant: Sparkasse publishes multiple dated tariff versions side by side (observed effective dates 2024-2026), which makes it unusually good for time-series analysis of fee changes, incl. card annual fees and account packages.

source_name: ПроКредит Банка АД Скопје — Тарифа за правни лица
why_relevant: SME-focused bank; corporate tariff shows business account packages, e-banking transfer pricing and business card/cash-handling fees — useful for merchant-side cash vs electronic cost comparison.

source_name: УНИБанка АД Скопје — Тарифа на надоместоци
why_relevant: UNIBanka is one of the five e-commerce acquiring banks; its tariff explicitly contains ATM fees charged to cards issued by other payment service providers — a direct read on cross-issuer ATM (surcharge/interchange pass-through) economics.

source_name: ТТК Банка АД Скопје — Тарифа за надоместоци (дел платежни сметки, ФЛ)
why_relevant: Mid-size bank; dated tariff extract for payment accounts and cards (observed file effective 08.10.2025). Useful for the smaller-bank pricing tier.

source_name: Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје — Целосна тарифа на надоместоци + Општи услови
why_relevant: Publishes a consolidated tariff covering both legal and physical persons plus dated general terms (observed 01.03.2026), including account maintenance fees tied to inflow bands — good for retail cash-handling economics.

source_name: Капитал банка АД Скопје — Тарифник за надоместоци на услуги (ФЛ и ПЛ)
why_relevant: Small bank tariff, including a separate legal-entities tariff with FX and denar payment-traffic amendments — useful for the low end of the market and for spotting outlier pricing.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Битола — Тарифник за надоместоци на услугите
why_relevant: Regional bank tariff page; regional/small-bank ATM and card pricing often deviates from Skopje majors, revealing where cash access is priced highest.

source_name: Провизии.мк — Тарифници (aggregator of all MK bank tariff documents)
why_relevant: Single hub claiming links to the official tariff documents of every MK bank, plus per-bank fee pages. The fastest way to maintain a complete, current URL registry for this cell and to detect newly published tariff versions.

source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Споредете ги надоместоците за платежни услуги
why_relevant: Official central-bank fee-comparison entry point mandated by the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems; the authoritative index of which providers publish fee information documents and where.

source_name: НБРСМ — Одлука за листа на најрепрезентативни услуги поврзани со платежната сметка и форма на информативниот документ за надоместоците
why_relevant: Defines the standardised fee vocabulary and template (FID/SoF equivalents) every MK provider must use — the schema key that makes cross-bank tariff comparison machine-comparable, including ATM cash withdrawal as a representative service.

source_name: Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (неофицијален пречистен текст, НБРСМ)
why_relevant: Defines 'заменски надоместок' (interchange fee) and 'надоместок од примачот на плаќањето' (merchant service charge) and the disclosure duties behind every tariff book — the legal frame that determines what must be public and how often it changes.

source_name: eCommerce4all.mk — E-payment processing / acquiring bank overview (Асоцијација за е-трговија)
why_relevant: Industry-association explainer naming the MK acquiring banks (Halkbank, Stopanska, NLB, Komercijalna, UNIBanka) and the fee stack merchants face — a useful actor map and sanity check when reading bank acquiring terms.

source_name: БанкоМетар (bankometar.mk) — компаративни анализи на банкарски надоместоци
why_relevant: Independent MK personal-finance site that periodically compiles cross-bank comparisons of account and card fees (e.g. which bank is cheapest for a transaction account) — a cheap early-warning signal that some bank changed its tariff.
